input.subject: Seminar on Artificial Intelligence and Future Technologies
input.body:
Dear All,

Greetings!!!

You are cordially invited to attend the Seminar on Artificial Intelligence and Future Technologies organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, SRMIST.

The seminar will be held on 14 June 2026 at 10:00 AM at the Seminar Hall, CSE Block A, SRMIST, Kattankulathur.

All faculty members and students are requested to attend and make use of this opportunity.

Thanks and Regards,
Dr. A. Ramesh
Head of Department
Department of Computer Science and Engineering
SRMIST, Kattankulathur

input.subject: National Level Technical Symposium – Technovanza 2026
input.body:
Dear All,

Greetings!!!

We are pleased to invite you to Technovanza 2026, the National Level Technical Symposium organized by SRMIST.

The symposium will be conducted from July 10 to July 12, 2026 starting at 09:00 AM each day at the Main Auditorium, SRMIST, Kattankulathur.

The event will feature paper presentations, hackathons, project expos, and guest lectures from industry experts.

All departments are requested to encourage maximum student participation.

Thanks and Regards,
Dr. P. Venkatesh
Dean, Faculty of Engineering and Technology
SRMIST, Kattankulathur

input.subject: Holiday Notice – Institution Closed on June 17, 2026
input.body:
Dear All,

This is to inform all faculty, staff, and students that the institution will remain closed on June 17, 2026 on account of a public holiday.

All scheduled activities, classes, and lab sessions for that day stand cancelled. Please plan accordingly.

For any urgent matters, kindly contact your respective department offices.

Thanks and Regards,
Administrative Office
SRMIST, Kattankulathur

expected_output.title: Holiday Notice – Institution Closed on June 17, 2026
expected_output.summary: The institution will remain closed on June 17, 2026 due to a public holiday. All activities, classes, and lab sessions are cancelled for the day.

input.subject: New Dress Code Policy for Laboratory Sessions
input.body:
Dear All,

This is to inform all students that a new dress code policy has been implemented for all laboratory sessions across all departments effective immediately.

Students must wear their lab coats and closed-toe shoes at all times during laboratory sessions. Students found violating this policy will not be permitted to attend the lab session.

Department coordinators are requested to ensure strict compliance.

Thanks and Regards,
Administrative Office
SRMIST, Kattankulathur

expected_output.title: New Dress Code Policy for Laboratory Sessions
expected_output.summary: A new dress code is effective immediately for all lab sessions. Students must wear lab coats and closed-toe shoes; non-compliance results in denied entry.

input.subject: End Semester Examination Timetable – November 2026
input.body:
Dear All,

Greetings!!!

This is to inform all students and faculty that the End Semester Examination Timetable for November 2026 has been released and is available on the SRMIST Student Portal.

Examinations will commence from November 10, 2026.

Students are advised to check their individual timetables on the portal at https://sp.srmist.edu.in and report any discrepancies to the Examination Cell before October 30, 2026.

Hall tickets will be available for download from November 3, 2026.

Thanks and Regards,
Controller of Examinations
SRMIST, Kattankulathur

expected_output.title: End Semester Examination Timetable Released – November 2026
expected_output.summary: The ESE timetable for November 2026 is available on the student portal. Exams start November 10, 2026. Discrepancies must be reported by October 30, 2026. Hall tickets downloadable from November 3, 2026.
